data.name: Muntazir
data.long_meaning: The name Muntazir is derived from the Arabic root word 'anzarah', which means 'to withhold' or 'to postpone'. In Islamic context, this name signifies the virtue of patience and endurance, as the one who bears the trials of life with steadfastness and hope for reward in the Hereafter.
